thesisQuality.note: Record backlog, 23% bookings growth, 11% MRR growth and dense interconnection footprint support durable demand/value capture; capital intensity prevents exceptional-band treatment.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Q2 MRR +11% YoY, AFFO/share +18% normalized constant-currency and raised 2026 guidance support the strong anchor; power/capacity execution remains a constraint.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: September 21 market cap about $104.3B and share price about $1,057 after a strong rerating indicate demanding valuation relative to even double-digit growth; evidence supports weak-to-mixed headroom, not a cheap asymmetry.

catalystScore.note: Raised 2026 guidance, record backlog and management's 2029 growth outlook provide multiple source-supported operating catalysts, though timing depends on capacity delivery.

governancePower.note: Current management has delivered raised guidance and strong AFFO/share growth with transparent SEC/IR reporting; evidence supports strong execution but does not establish exceptional long-duration stewardship.

alignment2036.note: Global colocation/interconnection infrastructure directly serves durable cloud, networking and AI-density needs across 77 metros; power-density growth reinforces long-duration strategic relevance.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: More than 10,500 customers, 522,000 interconnections, 282 data centers and 77 metros create multiple independent customer/geographic demand engines using the same platform.

bottleneckControl.note: High utilization, dense interconnection and constrained power/cooling capacity support control of scarce, difficult-to-replicate digital-infrastructure locations; utilities remain an external dependency.

scenarioRobustness.note: Global diversification and exposure to AI, cloud and networking provide several demand paths, offset by common dependence on power/cooling and capital delivery.

substitutionResilience.note: Large interconnection ecosystem and installed global footprint create qualification/network switching friction, while alternative architectures/locations remain credible substitutes for incremental workloads.

supplyChainResilience.note: Geographic breadth provides some resilience, but filings identify power/cooling/capacity delivery as meaningful dependencies and current evidence does not demonstrate exceptional redundancy.

pricingPower.note: Double-digit recurring revenue growth alongside AFFO/share expansion and high utilization supports demonstrated economic capture, but evidence does not isolate pure price realization from volume/mix.

risk.note: Material risks are capital intensity, constrained power/cooling delivery and a demanding current valuation; demand evidence remains strong, so risk is meaningful but not thesis-breaking.

confidence.note: Identity and operating claims are grounded in current SEC filings and issuer results; current valuation has an independent market source. Confidence is reduced for undisclosed AI-specific economics and supplier redundancy.

thesis: Equinix combines a globally distributed colocation footprint with a dense interconnection ecosystem that can capture durable AI/cloud/networking demand, while scarce power-ready capacity increases both strategic value and execution dependence.
keyRisk: Power/cooling and capital-delivery constraints can delay monetization while a demanding valuation leaves less room for execution misses.
nextCatalyst: Conversion of record backlog and raised 2026 guidance into sustained recurring-revenue and AFFO/share growth as new capacity is energized.
